BiblicalUsage: In Deborah's song the highways stood empty and travellers walked through crooked byways, and the psalm warns that those who turn aside to their crooked ways will be led away with the workers of iniquity. The word is winding, a path that will not run straight.
TheologicalSignificance: Crooked roads feel safer when the highways are dangerous, but the psalm says they end with the workers of iniquity.
